description: Permissions for the OIS main window and the whole-route windows it opens (#350): Tauri's core defaults, signed auto-update (#347), native notifications (#348), and creating and placing the windows themselves. A notification click raises the window from Rust (src/notify.rs), so the window controls here are for raising an already-open pop-out or route window, not for notification clicks. Pop-out panels get their own, narrower set — see popout.json.
